title: The Courage to Be Disliked
author: Ichiro Kishimi
summary: A young man argues with a philosopher over several nights about Adlerian psychology, including freedom from others' approval, separating tasks, and choosing how to live now.
readIf: you like ideas explored through dialogue and want a fresh take on happiness.
skipIf: you prefer research-backed studies over a conversational retelling of one theory.
